name: The Honored Ancestor keeps the creature attack power of its level (#12357)
contract: #7753 gave the Honored Ancestor 51265 (Ancestor's Call 804834), the Spectral Warden 100481 and the Spectral Scythe 250305 the
creature base damage and attack power of their level through PLAYERHOOK_ON_AFTER_GUARDIAN_INIT_STATS_FOR_LEVEL. The hook's
UpdateAllStats then ran Guardian::UpdateAttackPowerAndDamage, which replaced the attack power base with 2 x Strength - 20:
24 for the guardian fallback Strength of 22 at every level. creature_classlevelstats class 1 gives damage_base 5.4601 and
attackpower 42 at level 12, 33.9625 and 252 at level 60; Guardian::UpdateDamagePhysical adds attack power / 14 x 2.0 s
(BaseAttackTime 2000) to the weapon minimum. The level-12 Blood Elf of the report and a level-60 Draenei check both levels.
This does not add any scaling with the owner's Agility or attack power: no source states its size.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Honored Ancestor is summoned
DISCRIMINATING: level 12 minimum weapon damage is 5.46 + 42 / 14 x 2 = 11.46, not 8.89 from 24 attack power
SETUP: the Honored Ancestor is summoned
DISCRIMINATING: level 60 minimum weapon damage is 33.96 + 252 / 14 x 2 = 69.96, not 37.39 from 24 attack power
